translation.purpose: Native system font with Chinese fallback; the frontmatter gives the initial size. Users can adjust it within the implemented bounds.

empty-state-title.purpose: Primary orientation before the first translated caption.

english-source.purpose: Optional secondary text beneath the Chinese translation.

narrative.overview: Chinese captions form the main reading surface. SwiftUI system controls and AppKit window behavior provide the visual language. There are no custom branding assets, fonts, or authored animations. Native semantic colors and widgets are documented in DESIGN.md; browser HTML/CSS previews and synthetic tonal ramps are omitted because they would not represent the actual platform implementation.
keyCharacteristics: Chinese-first, selectable caption text with optional English below
System typography, semantic foregrounds, and standard controls
Resizable floating window with a fixed-size crop sheet
Textual status and specific recovery actions

rules.name: Native appearance
rules.body: Preserve SwiftUI semantic colors and platform control metrics; do not substitute an invented fixed palette.

rules.name: Chinese-first reading
rules.body: Keep Chinese translation visually primary and optional English below it in secondary foreground.

dos: Do preserve native keyboard, focus, and window behavior.
Do show state and recovery instructions in text.
Do preserve the crop preview's aspect ratio.
donts: Don't replace native semantic colors with fabricated fixed tokens.
Don't introduce decorative branding, cards, fonts, or animation.
